text: Ko woni sifa Aljanna Mo Allah fodi hulooɓe Mo ɓen: ko mo canɗi ndiyam woni e mun ɗam waylaaki fii neeɓde, e canɗi ɓira ɗam waylataa dakamme mun, e canɗi konnjam welanɗam yarooɓe, e canɗi njuuri laɓɓinaandi. Hino woodani ɓe kadi ton: noone kala e ɓiɗɓe leɗɗe ko ɓe faaletee, e yawtaneede junuubi immorde ka Allah. Hara ɓen ɗon wa'ay wa ɓe njoɓdi mun wonoyta luttinoyeede ka Yiite poomaa, ɓe yarnee ton diyam fatinaaɗam, ɗam taƴa tetekki maɓɓe ɗin, hakkee ko ɗam wuli?
